chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Declares His Intent to Cultivate - Desolate Era
chapter_meta_description: Four-year-old Ji Ning announces his intent to begin cultivation. After two years of reading and soul training through the Nuwa Diagram, he finally declares his path to his parents.
og_description: After two years of reading and soul cultivation through the Nuwa Diagram, young Ji Ning finally announces his desire to walk the path of immortality.
